answers.text/5601: Looks like your vampire blood saved you this time.
answers.text/5602: I never thought it would come to this...
answers.text/5605: You've lost some of your memory, it seems...
answers.text/5607: We fought the Immortals together. You haven't forgotten me, too?
answers.text/5608: I'm Otenko, messenger of the Sun.
answers.text/5610: First, we have to get out of this dungeon.
answers.text/5613: <PROC=1>The LIFE gauge at the top left shows your health.
answers.text/5614: When an enemy hurts you, your LIFE drops.
answers.text/5615: If it reaches zero, it's game over.
answers.text/5616: The ENE gauge below LIFE shows your spirit energy.
answers.text/5617: Your weapon, the Gun Del Sol, runs on magic...
answers.text/5619: We'll have to find somewhere to recharge...
answers.text/1043: A green potion. Restores a little LIFE.
answers.text/1046: Slow-dried monster meat. Restores some LIFE.
answers.text/1047: Roast monster meat. Restores a lot of LIFE.
answers.text/1049: A sweet treat. Restores a little LIFE.
answers.text/1051: Melted chocolate. Restores a little LIFE.
answers.text/1052: Something coated in chocolate. What could be inside?
answers.text/1053: A soda ice pop. Restores a little LIFE.
answers.text/1054: A cola ice pop. Restores a little LIFE.
answers.text/1055: A red potion. Restores a little ENE.
answers.text/1057: A poisonous mushroom. Restores ENE, but...
answers.text/1058: A blue potion that cures poison.
answers.text/1059: A yellow potion that cures poison and confusion.
answers.text/1060: Water purified by sunlight. Lifts Karmos's curse.
answers.text/1061: Sun-grown fruit. Helps you endure damage.
answers.text/1062: Sun-grown fruit. Makes you run faster.
answers.text/1064: A chocolate-coated banana. Carry things faster.
answers.text/1069: A leaf from the Solar Tree. Warps you outside the dungeon.
answers.text/1070: An old charm doll that drives away clouds.
answers.text/1071: An old charm doll that calls in clouds.
answers.text/1072: Old sandals for predicting the weather.
answers.text/1073: A stick that has served its purpose.
answers.text/1074: A stick stamped with a free ice pop. Give it to Gari-Gari Kun!
answers.text/1075: A card of wisdom. Raises Spirit.
answers.text/1076: A card of motherhood. Raises Body.
answers.text/1077: A card of courage. Raises Strength.
answers.text/1078: A card of destiny. Raises one stat.
answers.text/1079: A card of unease. Fully restores LIFE.
answers.text/1080: A card of happiness. Fully restores ENE.
answers.text/2158:
An age of darkness.
The Sun was forgotten.
answers.text/2159:
The Immortals appeared,
and terror swept the world.
answers.text/2160:
The living became the dead.
The dead roamed the earth.
answers.text/2161:
One warrior was all
the hope that remained.
answers.text/2162:
For a time it seemed
he had won back the Sun.
answers.text/2163:
Then a comrade betrayed him,
and the warrior fell.
answers.text/2166:
The world was sealed
in everlasting night.
answers.text/2167:
They say sunlight will
wake the warrior again.
answers.text/2169:
Who is left
to bring back the Sun?
answers.text/5460:
<LABEL=SABATA>Boy in Black</LABEL>
Where in the world...
answers.text/5464: If it is, it isn't mine.
answers.text/5466:
<LABEL=SABATA>Boy in Black</LABEL>
Are you the one who called me?
answers.text/5468: A seal of the Lunar Clan?
answers.text/5469: Then this is no ordinary monster...
answers.text/5472: The lunar blood in my veins... My people are warning me?!
answers.text/5474:
<LABEL=SABATA>Boy in Black</LABEL>
Already awake, are you?
answers.text/5477: You need my blood, the Lunar Maiden's power, to live again.
answers.text/5479: I'm putting you back to sleep. This time, forever!
answers.text/5481:
<LABEL=SABATA>Boy in Black</LABEL>
Gah! Could this thing be...?
answers.text/5489: Neither alive nor dead. It simply is. An Eternal.
answers.text/5491: Even you, the Dark Boy, cannot defeat it.
answers.text/5492: How can you kill something that has no life?
answers.text/5493: Even your little brother, Solar Boy <NAME>, can't do that.
answers.text/5495: But why would you bring a monster like that back?
answers.text/5497: Even if the galaxy wills its destruction,
answers.text/5498: you don't mean to destroy yourselves too, do you?
answers.text/5500:
<LABEL=RATA>Boy in White</LABEL>
That's why we need your help.
answers.text/5503:
<LABEL=RATA>Boy in White</LABEL>
They call me the Puppeteer.
answers.text/5504: Yet even I cannot pull the strings of an Eternal like Vanargand.
answers.text/5505: But you carry lunar blood, Dark Boy. For you it's different.
answers.text/5507: you can join souls with Vanargand.
answers.text/5508: You can become the Beast of Destruction itself.
answers.text/5509: All that power could be yours.
answers.text/5511: And you think I'd allow that?
answers.text/5516: A puppet has no need for a will of its own!
answers.text/5522:
<LABEL=SABATA>Boy in Black</LABEL>
You beat the Count, <NAME>!
answers.text/5523: Just what I'd expect of the Solar Boy...
answers.text/5526:
<LABEL=SABATA>Boy in Black</LABEL>
I'm Sabata, the Dark Boy.
answers.text/5527: Neither friend nor foe. For now, anyway...
answers.text/5531: I am the Dark Boy, chosen by the will of the galaxy!
answers.text/5532: I won't kneel to some Queen of Darkness.
answers.text/5537: There's no time left. We settle this now.
answers.text/5540: I bear Dark Matter. I wield the four elements, even the Sun!
answers.text/5541: You grew up safe and warm, sheltered by Father and Mother.
answers.text/5542: How can I lose to you?
answers.text/5549:
<LABEL=SABATA>Sabata</LABEL>
Our parents gave us the blood of the Sun and Moon.
answers.text/5550: Together, we can cover each other's weaknesses.
answers.text/5551: We'll defeat the Queen of Darkness and save our mother!
answers.text/5556: The will of the galaxy would cast off all life on this planet.
answers.text/5558: <LABEL=SABATA></LABEL>So you'll defy it. You're used to impossible odds by now, aren't you?
answers.text/5561: Dark, the will of the galaxy... the source of all life.
answers.text/5564: <LABEL=SABATA></LABEL>But I... I don't care how it ends.
answers.text/5565: What counts is how you live.
answers.text/5566: To resist. To keep fighting. That's what it means...
answers.text/5570:
<LABEL=SABATA>Sabata</LABEL>
We lost Mother. We struck down Father.
answers.text/5571: Still, we have to go on.
answers.text/5573: It's the only way to stand up to Dark, the will of the galaxy!
answers.text/6105: The ancient Solar Tree, the spirit of the earth.
answers.text/6107: This is more than old age. Is someone draining its power?
answers.text/6108: Could this be the Count's work, too?
answers.text/2419: Sunlight on the cartridge's sensor changes what happens in the game.
answers.text/9740: Shade the solar sensor, then press <WEIGHT>A</WEIGHT>.
